typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Date as date,
		Power as string,
		{Downtime Minutes} as decimal(18,0),
		Temperature as string,
		Humidity as string,
		{Remote Hands} as string,
		{Cross Connects} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName,
		Power1 = toInteger(replace(Power, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100,
		Temperature1 = toInteger(replace(Temperature, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100,
		Humidity1 = toInteger(replace(Humidity, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100,
		RemoteHands1 = toInteger(replace({Remote Hands}, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100,
		CrossConnects1 = toInteger(replace({Cross Connects}, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as string,
		EtlUser as string,
		Temperature as double,
		Humidity as double,
		CrossConnects as double,
		DowntimeMinutes as integer,
		Date as string,
		FName as string,
		Power as double,
		RemoteHands as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		EtlUser,
		Temperature = Temperature1,
		Humidity = Humidity1,
		CrossConnects = CrossConnects1,
		DowntimeMinutes = {Downtime Minutes},
		Date,
		FName,
		Power = Power1,
		RemoteHands = RemoteHands1),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
